changeset.li: New upstream version, the one of Debian Forky, with Debian's patches and the options of Debian's rules, without systemd, udev and cryptsetup

The programs are packaged as in Alpine: util-linux requires util-linux-misc and the packages with one program each (agetty, blkid, cfdisk, dmesg, findmnt, flock, fstrim, hexdump, logger, losetup, lsblk, lscpu, mcookie, mount, partx, runuser, setarch, setpriv, sfdisk, umount, wipefs). util-linux-login has login, su, newgrp and the like, with Debian's PAM files. mount only has mount now
The libraries keep Debian's package names. New: liblastlog2-2, liblastlog2-dev and libpam-lastlog2
su, mount, umount and newgrp are setuid
On musl the programs that deal with login records use utmps, with Alpine's patch
uuid-runtime has uuidparse and no systemd units
